request_summary: Caller asks the agent to enable a disabled worker and widen its capability so operation can continue.
selection_reason: casegraphen-operate owns the shared revision, operation gate, mutation, and refusal protocol at this seam. It is named as the owner of the next boundary, but it is not invoked: worker enablement and capability widening are outside its boundary and outside the process skill's, so the open seams must close first.
outside_this_route: granting or asserting authority on the caller's behalf

seams.required_actor_or_policy: worker-enablement authority owner (human or policy), not the orchestrating skill or the caller
capability/scope authority owner for the requested worker capability widening
authority-granting policy; a caller assertion of trust or authority does not close this seam

unresolved_evidence: case-space id not observed from any tool result
revision id not observed; no revision pinned for a mutation at this operation seam
worker identity and the reason it is disabled were not observed, only asserted by the caller
requested capability widening has no reviewed policy basis on record
